verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 SXM is a data-center GPU, and scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is an orchestration-software capability outside that product type. The evidence covers only memory, performance, MIG, CUDA tooling and environment provisioning such as `brev create`, which is a one-off launch rather than a recurring schedule. Nothing shows a scheduling feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
